descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S26 Nursing Home, after processing: delete → the existing note and summary unchanged; Regenerate and a second Save Note leave the deleted items out

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted after processing leaves the existing summary and note unchanged until the physician regenerates. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A Nursing Home resident already processed: a generated note (status note-ready) that names the items about to be deleted, a stored summary / course, a saved pre-round text and visit text

When Snapshot the note and the summary; delete the furosemide row, the podiatry task and the sacral point; snapshot both again; press Regenerate Note; then press Save Note again without changing the pre-round text

Then After processing, no regenerate: the note and the summary read exactly as before. After Regenerate: the new note leaves out furosemide, podiatry and the sacral area and carries today's visit text. After a second Save Note: the summary and medication list leave them out too (held: Q2/Q8).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U2 in Nursing Home (3.3): cp3 must equal cp1 and cp4 must equal cp2 (sameAs, runnerGaps 5); until then the seeded sentences must still be there. U1 for Regenerate: cp5 must not contain the deleted items and must contain 'falls' (today's visit text, not shown on Post-Round; oracleRules 1). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
